market_view: Thanksgiving: no US stock or options session today (the TSX is open); only crypto and futures trade, on thin holiday volume. Wednesday reversed hard: S&P from -3.2% at 9:45 to -0.3%, Nasdaq 100 -4.8% to -0.7%, Dow from -1,100 points to +0.3%, after hot PCE (3.8%, core 3.3% vs 3.2%), proposed new tariffs pushed to January at the earliest, falling yields (10-year 4.85%) and Michael Burry saying he is 'almost entirely long'. VIX still closed up at 28.3. Futures +0.5% this morning; WTI US$84.4 after a Houthi strike on a Saudi refinery, gold US$3,620, BTC US$60,600 with Fear & Greed 11.
